arms.B0_naive: baseline: flag any binary that mentions a syscall the runtime does not implement
arms.B5_justrun: baseline: run once and report the exit code only
arms.S1_full: the current scanner with the KB, static plus dynamic evidence
arms.S3_native: native execution under runc as the reference run
arms.ordering: ABBA within each case block, with the position recorded as order_index and the sequence as order_pattern

claims_ceiling.published_constraint: every claim in the dataset card and the results tables states its ceiling
claims_ceiling.reason: ground truth comes from raw exit codes, runsc debug logs and stdout diffs adjudicated by a documented rule, not by two independent human raters, so the study cannot support L3 or above

corpus.blocked_reason: A case is registered only when its workload artifact is present and digest-verifiable on this host; three planned cases stay unregistered until their images are fetched.
corpus.labels_at_registration: every ready case has label null; no class is assigned before registration
corpus.v1_bar: PRD v1.0 requires 60 cases with 20 or more positives and documented kappa. This study does not reach that bar and reports it as unmet rather than relaxing the requirement.

deviation_log.rule: entries are appended with a date, the affected hypothesis and the reason; the sealed registration content above never changes

exclusion_rules.handling: an invalidated run keeps its record and its artifacts in bench/runs with valid false and an invalid_reason; nothing is deleted, and no run is dropped because of its outcome
invalidates_a_run: the recorded digests do not re-verify
never_invalidates: a verdict that disagrees with the label
exclusion_rules.preflight: a failed blocking check marks the run invalid rather than preventing it, so the attempt stays on the record

fixed_inputs.float_rule: values are rounded to 6 digits before they enter any hashed artifact, so interpreter differences cannot change a digest

hosts.constraint: Live work runs on the ext4 WSL home, never under /mnt/c, because the 9p mount breaks symlinks and distorts timings; preflight work-root rejects it
hosts.windows-1: bench/hosts/windows-1.json - Windows 11 host, analysis and static scanning only; no live sandbox execution
hosts.wsl2-1: bench/hosts/wsl2-1.json - WSL2 Ubuntu host with the digest-pinned runsc; native versus sandbox execution happens here

hypotheses.comparator: B0_naive and B5_justrun on the identical case set
hypotheses.decision_rule: claim an advantage only when the paired exact test survives Holm correction and the direction is consistent across the development and validation splits
hypotheses.estimator: Wilson 95 percent interval for each rate, McNemar exact test with discordant counts for the paired comparison
hypotheses.primary_endpoint: presence and absence of a hard-failure or silent-degradation verdict against the adjudicated label
hypotheses.statement: The scanner separates runtime-incompatible behaviour from compatible behaviour better than B0 and B5 on the registered cases.

hypotheses.comparator: the dynamic ground truth recorded for the same binary
hypotheses.decision_rule: report the intervals; no threshold is invented, and a link style with fewer than 10 binaries is labelled exploratory
hypotheses.estimator: Clopper-Pearson 95 percent interval on recall, geometric mean across link styles
hypotheses.primary_endpoint: per-binary precision, recall and resolution rate over a known-behaviour gcc corpus
hypotheses.statement: Static syscall extraction recovers the syscalls a compiled binary actually reaches, and its rate does not depend on link style.

hypotheses.comparator: the unmodified trace of the same workload
hypotheses.decision_rule: acceptance requires zero false-complete; any positive count is a product defect and is published, not re-run until it passes
hypotheses.estimator: exact count plus Clopper-Pearson upper bound on the false-complete rate
hypotheses.primary_endpoint: count of injected-fault cases whose prediction class is compatible
hypotheses.statement: A corrupted or truncated trace never yields a completed compatibility claim.

hypotheses.decision_rule: acceptance requires zero unresolved crashers; each crash is recorded with its digest and either fixed or listed as open
hypotheses.estimator: counts by input class with Holm-corrected proportions
hypotheses.primary_endpoint: crash, timeout and limit-violation counts over the seeded mutation corpus
hypotheses.statement: Malformed inputs are handled within the documented limits: no crash, no unbounded memory, no silent success.

hypotheses.decision_rule: a regression claim requires more than 20 percent worsening confirmed by two consecutive runs
hypotheses.estimator: median and nearest-rank percentiles over repetitions, Mann-Whitney U with Cliff's delta between steps, geometric mean across workloads
hypotheses.primary_endpoint: wall time and peak RSS at each ladder point (256 MiB file, 1 GiB rootfs, 4 GiB expanded layers, 100000 paths, 512 layers, 128 MiB report)
hypotheses.statement: Scanner runtime and peak memory grow predictably with input size up to the documented caps in LIMITATIONS.md.

hypotheses.comparator: the same artifact produced on the other host and interpreter
hypotheses.decision_rule: acceptance requires the empty mismatch set; a single differing byte is a failure and is diagnosed, not excused
hypotheses.estimator: digest equality, reported as a set of mismatches
hypotheses.primary_endpoint: sha256 of every generated table and figure
hypotheses.statement: Analysis output is reproducible byte for byte from the recorded inputs, on either interpreter.

hypotheses.comparator: the same case on the other platform with everything else pinned
hypotheses.decision_rule: verdict disagreement on any case is a finding regardless of the timing result; timing claims are reported separately from compatibility claims
hypotheses.estimator: bootstrap BCa interval on the ratio with 2000 replicates, percentile and BCa reported together
hypotheses.primary_endpoint: paired runtime ratio and verdict equality per case
hypotheses.statement: The gVisor platform axis (systrap versus KVM) changes measured runtime but not the compatibility verdict.

kb_age_policy.compatibility_arm: --max-kb-age-days 400 so a stale knowledge base cannot make a compatibility verdict indeterminate for a reason unrelated to the workload
kb_age_policy.reason: the snapshot is older than 30 days, so the product default marks every scan incomplete; conflating that with workload behaviour would mislabel the entire corpus
kb_age_policy.rule: two arms, declared before any run
kb_age_policy.staleness_arm: the product default of 30 days is exercised separately as the thing being measured, not as a confounder to be removed

known_limitations: single gVisor release and amd64 only; the Kata and arm64 axes are not run here
a desktop host with about 7 GiB RAM and no cpufreq governor control: the governor is recorded as null and timing claims are marked as uncontrolled-host measurements
the corpus is author-selected, which is a documented sampling bias
the registry is pinned by digest but a re-resolve of a mutable tag can drift; only digests are trusted
B0 and B5 baselines are reimplemented in the harness, so they are the harness reading of those baselines rather than the original tools

mapping_validation_snapshot.reading: The mapping reaches every class the schema permits and sends no static-only or incomplete report to compatible, which is the failure mode PRD section 4.5 forbids.

prediction_map.validated_on: 34 retained reports in artifacts/ that pre-date this registration; the mapping was fixed before that snapshot and is not refitted to scored data

preregistration_rule: This document is sealed before any scored run. Registered content is immutable; anything that departs from it is appended to the deviation log with the reason and the date, never edited in place.

primary_analysis.method: bench analyze reads bench/runs only; a table cell whose inputs have no run.json fails the build instead of being filled
primary_analysis.no_fabrication: no number in any published table or figure is authored by hand
primary_analysis.population: every recorded run that is valid for its suite, in full

splits.rule: The test split is scored once, after the development and validation analysis is written, and is never used to choose a threshold or to re-fit a rule.

statistics.aggregation: geometric mean across workloads, never arithmetic
statistics.agreement: Cohen's kappa for two raters, Fleiss' kappa for more; a rule-adjudicator is never counted as a human rater
statistics.distributions: nearest-rank percentiles 50/90/99, Mann-Whitney U with tie and continuity correction, Cliff's delta
statistics.intervals_for_ratios: BCa bootstrap, 2000 replicates, fixed seed, cluster bootstrap by case so a case with several repetitions does not outweigh a case with one
statistics.multiplicity: Holm step-down across the registered hypothesis family at alpha 0.05
statistics.multiplicity_free_monitoring: two-sided DKW bound reported where a distribution comparison is descriptive only
statistics.paired_binary: exact McNemar on discordant counts, normal approximation only when counts exceed 25
statistics.proportions: Wilson 95 percent (default), Clopper-Pearson for a conservative bound on recall and false-complete rates
statistics.regression_detection: change-point comparison against a warm-up baseline, requiring two consecutive confirmations past a 20 percent practical threshold

title: SENTRYCHECK runtime-compatibility benchmark: measurement plan and pre-registration
